recipes.name: Classic French Omelette
steps: Beat eggs lightly. Melt butter in non-stick pan.
Stir rapidly until almost set, then roll into cigar shape.

recipes.name: Coq au Vin
steps: Render bacon, brown chicken. Sauté onion and mushrooms.
Deglaze with red wine, add stock and herbs.
Simmer 1–1.5 hrs.

recipes.name: Ratatouille
steps: Sauté onion and garlic. Add vegetables in stages.
Add tomatoes and herbs. Simmer until tender.

recipes.name: Boeuf Bourguignon
steps: Brown beef and bacon. Sauté vegetables.
Deglaze with red wine, add stock and herbs.
Braise 2–2.5 hrs.

recipes.name: Crème Brûlée
steps: Infuse cream with vanilla. Temper into yolks + sugar.
Bake in water bath until just set.
Chill. Torch sugar until caramelized.

recipes.name: Beurre Blanc
steps: Reduce wine + vinegar + shallot to syrup.
Off heat, whisk in cold butter cubes.
Season and serve immediately.

recipes.name: French Onion Soup
steps: Caramelize onions slowly in butter.
Deglaze with wine, add stock and thyme.
Top with bread and cheese, broil.

recipes.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
steps: Melt chocolate + butter. Whisk eggs + sugar, fold in chocolate and flour.
Bake in ramekins 10–12 min until edges set, center molten.

recipes.name: Sole Meunière
steps: Dredge sole in flour.
Sauté in clarified butter until golden.
Finish with lemon and parsley butter.

recipes.name: Quiche Lorraine
steps: Make shortcrust, blind bake.
Fill with bacon, cheese, egg-cream.
Bake until set.

recipes.name: Tarte Tatin
steps: Caramelize sugar and butter.
Arrange apples, top with pastry.
Bake, then invert.

recipes.name: Gratin Dauphinois
steps: Slice potatoes thin. Layer with cream, garlic, salt.
Bake covered then uncovered until tender and golden.

recipes.name: Duck Confit
steps: Cure duck legs with salt and herbs.
Rinse, submerge in duck fat.
Cook very low 3–4 hrs. Crisp skin before serving.

recipes.name: Steak Frites
steps: Cook steak to preferred doneness, rest.
Make fries (double fry).
Finish steak with butter, garlic, parsley.

recipes.name: Hollandaise
steps: Whisk yolks with water over gentle heat.
Slowly emulsify in warm clarified butter.
Season with lemon and salt.

recipes.name: Confit Garlic
steps: Submerge peeled cloves in olive oil with thyme.
Cook at 90–100°C until soft and sweet.
Store in oil.

recipes.name: Salade Niçoise
steps: Cook eggs, beans, potatoes.
Arrange with tuna and tomato.
Dress with olive oil and lemon.

recipes.name: Croque Monsieur
steps: Make béchamel.
Assemble sandwich with ham and cheese, top with béchamel.
Bake or broil until golden.

recipes.name: French Toast
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, cinnamon, vanilla.
Soak bread. Cook in butter until golden.

recipes.name: Chicken Stock
steps: Cover bones and vegetables with cold water.
Bring slowly to simmer, skim.
Simmer 2–3 hrs. Strain.
